column12: Methodology:  To achieve the Accuracy value, I convert the letter grades into numeric grades from 1-10 rising in .75 increments and I'm using a punishing formula that deducts 20% for each step grade away I am from the 4wk 17lands data. With this, if I am more than 4 grades away from the data the result would be 0% and heavily impact the total average. The formula being used to calculate individual card performance is:  || =MAX(0, 1 - ((ABS(prediction - data) / 0.75) * 0.2)) ||
